column3: One word for the stored record of one flight, and one for the per-CM graded view? The doc mixes Session / Report / Debriefing / Save file.
column4: Session = the record; Debrief = one Crew Member's view of a Session, where Grades are set. Avoid "report" and "save file".

column3: One sector, or a whole multi-sector check?
column4: One sector (or one sim session). Multi-sector checks = duplicate for the next leg.

column3: Seat/role positions (CM1 = left seat/commander) or just "first/second entered"?
column4: Positions with the standard SOP meaning; always labelled CM1/CM2; staff numbers only, no names.

column3: Must an earlier Debrief state stay retrievable after later edits?
column4: No. One living Session, autosaved. "Generate debriefing" just opens the Debrief; "Save report" becomes "Done".

column3: Is a zero-Note Competency automatically "Not Observed"?
column4: No. Not Observed is a deliberate Grade; nothing is auto-graded. Ungraded Competencies show in the leave warning.

column3: Removed ids, reused ids, placeholder-era Sessions?
column4: Ids are never removed or reused, only added or renamed. Old Sessions show the latest names; unknown ids render as the raw id. Placeholder Sessions are test data.

column3: Removed on the keystroke that empties it, or later?
column4: When it loses focus, with an undo snackbar that brings back the CM tag and OB.

column3: What does a staff number look like at the operator?
column4: If unknown or it varies: letters and digits, uppercased, 1-10 characters; no pattern or roster in the MVP.
v0.2, as a passphrase-encrypted export. MVP data lives on one device only.

column3: When does it lock, and what if the device has no screen lock?
column4: Cold start and after 5 min in background. No device screen lock means the app can't be used.
